title: Saltspire (Choose Context)
description: An original example of context-tier-aware Multiple Choice navigation, modeled on Villain's Academy. The root is pure navigation: it branches by context size so each leaf carries a card budget suited to the player's tier. The root's own plot components are intentionally empty, because on a Multiple Choice scenario only leaf branches affect play.
prompt: Welcome to Saltspire. First, choose your preferred context size. Free and low-context players should pick Low Context for a lean card set that fits a small budget. Higher-tier players can pick High Context for the full city.
